question: Can the monetary-policy variance input be audited under persistent but stationary Gaussian shocks?
data: Synthetic stationary Gaussian AR(1); no empirical macroeconomic dataset
hypothesis: For every n-rho cell, the two-sided Wilson 95% lower bound of exact GLS interval coverage is at least 0.80; this is an engineering screening threshold, not a theorem test.
regime: stationary Gaussian AR(1), known rho, unknown mean and marginal variance
hardware: Linux 6.18.57 x86_64; AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor; 9 logical CPUs exposed; no accelerator
toolchain: requirements.txt pins; benchmark excludes installation and import time
